title: Acquirer: Ridley Agriproducts Pty Ltd (Ridley Corporation Limited); Target: Tableland Stockfeed Specialists Pty Ltd (Athmaize Co)
acquirers: Ridley Agriproducts Pty Ltd (Ridley Corporation Limited)
targets: Tableland Stockfeed Specialists Pty Ltd (Athmaize Co)

body_sections.Summary: The parties informed the ACCC of a proposed unincorporated joint venture between Ridley Agriproducts Pty Ltd and Tableland Stockfeed Specialists Pty Ltd.  The parties manufacture and distribute stockfeed in the Atherton Tableland region of Queensland.
body_sections.Market definition: For competition assessment purposes, the relevant market in this instance was considered to be the Atherton Tableland regional market for the supply of stockfeed.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Although the ACCC's concentration thresholds are crossed, barriers to entry are relatively low and the jv parties will be constrained by Fred Barletta, a competitor who is expected to provide vigorous and effective competition in the market.  On this basis the ACCC determined that a substantial lessening of competition was unlikely.
